Hi team,

The wifi in the Oak conference room now uses the new corporate SSID. If your laptop still shows the old network, forget it in your settings and reconnect; the password is in 1Password under Office Network.

Separately, Bluetooth pairing with the room's display works again after the firmware update Ingrid Solberg pushed on Monday.

Thanks,
Felix
